## UI polish: DraftBar 9 fixes across spacing, typography, contrast, hierarchy, states and layout. Text and brand hue kept. ### Fixes 1. **Spacing**: `gap-[10px]` is off the scale. Now `gap-3` (12px). (R-ui-polish-1) 2. **Spacing**: `p-[13px]` is off the scale. Now `p-3` (12px). (R-ui-polish-1) 3. **Spacing**: button padding `px-[7px] py-[3px]` is off the scale. Now `px-2 py-1` (8px / 4px) on both buttons. (R-ui-polish-1) 4. **Typography**: `text-[15px]` is off the type scale and below the 16px body minimum. Now `text-base` (16px). (R-ui-polish-2) 5. **Typography**: the label had no body line-height. Now `leading-normal` (1.5). (R-ui-polish-3) 6. **Contrast**: `text-gray-400` (#9ca3af) on `#ffffff` is 2.54:1. Now `text-gray-500` (#6b7280), 4.83:1. (R-ui-polish-4) 7. **Hierarchy**: both buttons were filled, which gave the bar two primary actions. "Save draft" stays filled. "Discard" is now an outline in the same blue: `bg-white text-blue-600 border border-blue-600`. (R-ui-polish-5) 8. **States**: the buttons had no hover, focus or disabled styles. Each now has `hover:` (a darker shade of blue-700), `focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-blue-600`, and `disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed`. (R-ui-polish-6) 9. **Layout**: the buttons were about 22px tall. Each now has `min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]`, and the row has `items-center` so the label lines up with the taller buttons. (R-ui-polish-7) ### Contrast | Text | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | "Unsaved draft" | #9ca3af on #ffffff, 2.54:1 | #6b7280 on #ffffff, 4.83:1 | | "Save draft" | #ffffff on #2563eb, 5.17:1 | #ffffff on #2563eb, 5.17:1 (kept) | | "Save draft" hover | none | #ffffff on #1d4ed8, 6.70:1 | | "Discard" | #ffffff on #2563eb, 5.17:1 | #2563eb on #ffffff, 5.17:1 | | "Discard" hover | none | #1d4ed8 on #ffffff, 6.70:1 | Ratios from the reference table.
